units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 7:9">Ib. 9</cite> <he>בס׳</he> (sub. <cite ref="D00633"><he>נידון</he></cite>) is to be put to death by stoning.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 9:3">Ib.</cite> <he>הס׳ חמורה</he> stoning is the severer punishment; a. v. fr.—<he>בית הס׳</he> the place of stoning, a scaffolding from which the culprit was thrown down. Ib. VI, 1. Ib. 4 <he>בית הס׳ היה וכ׳</he> the scaffolding was two (men’s) statures high; a. e.
